🏛️ Congressional Trades Dashboard

⚠️ Disclaimer: This dashboard displays U.S. House of Representatives Periodic Transaction Reports — public records filed under the STOCK Act of 2012 and sourced from the Office of the Clerk (disclosures-clerk.house.gov). It is provided for informational purposes only and is not financial, investment, or legal advice. Dollar figures are estimates based on the mid-point of disclosed amount ranges. A flagged “potential conflict” reflects a sector/committee overlap only and is not evidence of wrongdoing. Data may be incomplete or contain parsing errors; always verify against the original filing before relying on any figure.
